source_caption:
EJAE has spoken about being rejected as an idol trainee before building a successful career as a songwriter behind the scenes. That background makes her involvement in KPop Demon Hunters especially fitting—her voice on “Golden” carries the kind of perseverance and authenticity the film is built around.

KPop Demon Hunters (2025), directed by Maggie Kang & Chris Appelhans, starring Arden Cho, May Hong, Ji-young Yoo. A high-energy animated musical where K-pop superstars secretly live double lives as demon hunters, blending music, action, and identity into a global pop spectacle.

source_details.synopsis: KPop Demon Hunters is a 2025 American animated musical urban fantasy film co-written and directed by Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans. Produced by Sony Pictures Animation for Netflix, the film stars the voices of Arden Cho, Ahn Hyo-seop, May Hong, Ji-young Yoo, Yunjin Kim, Daniel Dae Kim, Ken Jeong, and Lee Byung-hun. The story follows a K-pop girl group, Huntrix (Rumi, Mira, and Zoey), who lead double lives as demon hunters. They face off against a rival boy band, the Saja Boys, whose members are secretly demons.
